name: Ranger
description: A warrior who uses martial prowess and nature magic to combat threats on the edges of civilization.
starting_equipment: Two Shortswords or Two Simple Melee Weapons

features.name: Favored Enemy
features.description: You have significant experience studying, tracking, hunting, and even talking to a certain type of enemy. Choose a type of favored enemy. You always have Hunter's Mark prepared, and it doesn't count against the number of spells you know. You can cast Hunter's Mark a number of times equal to your favored enemy bonus (see table) without expending a spell slot. You regain all uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: By 1st level, you have learned to use the magical essence of nature to cast spells. You know a number of spells equal to your Ranger level + 1. You can change which spells you know when you gain a level in this class. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for your ranger spells.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: You learn mastery with 2 weapons of your choice.

features.name: Deft Explorer
features.description: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice from the Ranger skill list. You also learn two additional languages of your choice.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. You can choose one fighting style from the list, or you can choose Druidic Warrior to learn two cantrips from the druid spell list.

features.name: Ranger Archetype
features.description: At 3rd level, you choose an archetype that you strive to emulate. Your choice grants you features at 3rd level and again at 7th, 11th, and 15th level.

features.name: Primeval Awareness
features.description: You can use your action to focus your awareness on the region around you. For 1 minute per level of the spell slot you expend, you can sense whether certain types of creatures are present.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1. Alternatively, you can take a feat.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Favored Enemy Improvement
features.description: You choose one additional favored enemy, as well as an associated language.

features.name: Natural Explorer Improvement
features.description: You choose one additional favored terrain.

features.name: Ranger Archetype Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Ranger Archetype.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1. Alternatively, you can take a feat.

features.name: Land's Stride
features.description: Starting at 8th level, moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs you no extra movement. You can also pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them.

features.name: Natural Explorer Improvement
features.description: You choose one additional favored terrain.

features.name: Hide in Plain Sight
features.description: Starting at 10th level, you can spend 1 minute creating camouflage for yourself. Once camouflaged in this way, you can try to hide by pressing yourself up against a solid surface.

features.name: Ranger Archetype Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Ranger Archetype.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1. Alternatively, you can take a feat.

features.name: Favored Enemy Improvement
features.description: You choose one additional favored enemy, as well as an associated language.

features.name: Vanish
features.description: Starting at 14th level, you can use the Hide action as a bonus action on your turn. Also, you can't be tracked by nonmagical means, unless you choose to leave a trail.

features.name: Ranger Archetype Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Ranger Archetype.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1. Alternatively, you can take a feat.

features.name: Feral Senses
features.description: At 18th level, you gain preternatural senses that help you fight creatures you can't see. When you attack a creature you can't see, your inability to see it doesn't impose disadvantage on your attack rolls against it. You are also aware of the location of any invisible creature within 30 feet of you.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1. Alternatively, you can take a feat.

features.name: Foe Slayer
features.description: At 20th level, you become an unparalleled hunter of your enemies. Once on each of your turns, you can add your Wisdom modifier to the attack roll or the damage roll of an attack you make against one of your favored enemies. You can choose to use this feature before or after the roll, but before any effects of the roll are applied.

subclasses.name: Hunter
subclasses.description: Emulating the Hunter archetype means accepting your place as a bulwark between civilization and the terrors of the wilderness. As you walk the Hunter's path, you learn specialized techniques for fighting the threats you face, from rampaging ogres and hordes of orcs to towering giants and terrifying dragons.

3.name: Hunter's Lore
3.description: If you add a Hunter's Mark, you know also all creature immunities, resistances, or vulnerabilities.

3.name: Hunter's Prey
3.description: You gain one of the following features of your choice: Colossus Slayer (Once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, deal extra 1d8 damage if target is below max HP. If you miss, you still do this damage once per turn), Giant Killer (When a Large+ creature attacks you, use reaction to attack it), or Horde Breaker (Once per turn, when you make an attack and hit, you can make another attack to another creature 5ft from the first one). You can replace your choice at a long or short rest.

subclasses.name: Fey Wanderer
subclasses.description: A fey mystique surrounds you, thanks to the boon of an archfey, the touch of a god, a blessing from a dryad, or some other fey magic. You might have spent time in the Feywild, growing so close to the fey that some of their magic has become yours.

3.name: Dreadful Strikes
3.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon, you can add 1d4 psychic damage (once per turn). The damage increases to 1d6 at level 11.

3.name: Fey Wanderer Spells
3.description: You learn additional spells when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Fey Wanderer Spells table. These spells are always prepared and don't count against the number of spells you know.

3.name: Fey Gift
3.description: You add a fey gift. Select one of: Illusory butterflies flutter around you while you take a short or long rest; Fresh, seasonal flowers sprout from your hair each dawn; You faintly smell of cinnamon, lavender, nutmeg, or another comforting herb or spice; Your shadow dances while no one is looking directly at it; Horns or antlers sprout from your head; Your skin and hair change color to match the season at each dawn.

3.name: Otherworldly Glamour
3.description: When you make a Charisma check, you gain a bonus equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1). You also gain proficiency in one of: Deception, Performance, or Persuasion.

subclasses.name: Gloom Stalker
subclasses.description: Gloom Stalkers are at home in the darkest places: deep under the earth, in gloomy alleyways, in primeval forests, and wherever else the light dims. Most folk enter such places with trepidation, but a Gloom Stalker ventures boldly into the darkness, seeking to ambush threats before they can reach the broader world.

3.name: Dread Ambusher
3.description: At the start of your first turn, your speed increases by 10ft. When you attack a creature and hit, you can add 2d6 physical damage (once per turn). You can use this a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier. You regain all uses when you finish a long rest. You also add your Wisdom modifier to your initiative.

3.name: Gloom Stalker Spells
3.description: You learn additional spells when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Gloom Stalker Spells table. These spells are always prepared and don't count against the number of spells you know.

3.name: Umbral Sight
3.description: You gain darkvision of 60ft. If you already have darkvision, add 60ft to it.

subclasses.name: Beast Master
subclasses.description: The Beast Master archetype embodies a friendship between the civilized races and the beasts of the world. United in focus, beast and ranger work as one to fight the monstrous foes that threaten civilization and the wilderness alike.

3.name: Ranger's Companion
3.description: You gain a beast companion that accompanies you on your adventures and is trained to fight alongside you. Choose a beast that is no larger than Medium and that has a challenge rating of 1/4 or lower. At every long rest, you can change your companion. Your companion acts independently of you, but it always obeys your commands. In combat, it rolls its own initiative and acts on its own turn. A companion can't attack, but it can take other actions as normal.
